title: Viva Insights: GitHub Copilot spend and usage page in the Consumption Dashboard
summary: The briefing passes: the access controls, licensing background and reporting limits are supported. It explicitly distinguishes the roadmap's launched, enabled-by-default dashboard from Learn's GitHub public preview requiring enablement in Privacy settings.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes GitHub Copilot spend and usage insights in Viva Insights.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment; controls[0].note; rationale: risk

claims.where: What's changing; Scope; controls[1].note; Open questions
claims.claim: A manager's team size includes the manager and direct and indirect reports.
claims.quote: Team size includes: The manager; All employees who directly report to the manager; All employees who indirectly report to the manager through the organizational reporting hierarchy

claims.where: What's changing; Scope; controls[1].note; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Managers need to meet the Minimum team size setting, whose lowest allowed value is five.
claims.quote: Only managers whose team size meets or exceeds the Minimum team size setting can access insights in the Viva Insights web app. The minimum team size must be set to at least five.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment; Scope; Open questions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Learn marks the GitHub page as a public preview, unlike the roadmap's launched status.
claims.quote: This feature is for public preview customers only. Features in preview might not be complete and could undergo changes before becoming available in the broader release.

claims.where: controls[2].ui; What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Learn directs administrators to Privacy settings in the Viva Insights web app to enable the GitHub preview, without documenting a longer route.
claims.quote: To enable this preview feature, go to Privacy settings in the Viva Insights web app.

claims.claim: GitHub data before July 10, 2026 might be under-reported.
claims.quote: GitHub data prior to July 10, 2026, might be under-reported due to a source issue.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: On days 28 to 31 of a month, the GitHub page represents the previous 28 days instead of the full month to date.
claims.quote: Unlike the Microsoft 365 services pages, which displays the full month to date, on days 28-31 of the month, the GitHub page only represents data over the previous 28 days.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: GitHub group metrics are hidden below the minimum group size.
claims.quote: To protect individual privacy, metrics aren't shown for groups that are smaller than the minimum group size.

claims.claim: Identification can expose named employees instead of anonymised metrics in the Consumption Dashboard.
claims.quote: Identification lets your organization move from anonymized metrics to known users, surfacing named employees (identified outputs) when added precision is needed and permitted.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls
claims.claim: The unified exclusion list can exclude employees from Consumption Dashboard aggregates.
claims.quote: Your organization might want to exclude certain users from being included in the aggregated insights in the Microsoft Copilot Dashboard, Agent Dashboard, Consumption Dashboard, or Viva Insights behavior collaboration reports in advanced analysis

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls
claims.claim: The unified exclusion list is managed through Viva Feature Access Management.
claims.quote: You can manage the exclusion list with Viva Feature Access Management (VFAM) using PowerShell or VFAM.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls
claims.claim: The exclusion list requires its policy to be turned on.
claims.quote: To use an exclusion list, you must turn on the policy.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn does not document how this page matches GitHub Copilot activity to Microsoft Entra users.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Insights GitHub Copilot Consumption Dashboard identity matching Microsoft Entra users licensing prerequisites. Read ai-cost-dashboard, github-query and Copilot Analytics introduction; none describes the GitHub-to-Entra matching mechanism.

claims.claim: Access only to the Microsoft Copilot and Agent Dashboard does not entitle a user to the Consumption Dashboard.
claims.quote: Currently, consumption insights are only available to the users listed above. The Consumption Dashboard is not available for users who have access to the Microsoft Copilot and Agent Dashboard in the Viva Insights web app

claims.claim: Analysts in non-global partitions do not get consumption insights.
claims.quote: Currently, consumption insights are not available to analysts in non-global partitions.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Open questions
claims.claim: Consumption Dashboard access cannot currently be delegated.
claims.quote: If you have access to the dashboard, you can't currently delegate access to other people in your company.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Viva Insights requires applicable Viva Insights licensing.
claims.quote: Viva Insights requires the applicable Viva Insights licensing and a Microsoft 365 or Office 365 tenant with Exchange Online Plan 1 or Plan 2.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Microsoft Copilot plans include manager, leader and advanced analysis for employees with an assigned Copilot licence.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot plans also include manager, leader, and advanced analysis for all employees who have an assigned Copilot license.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: A licensing requirement specific to the Consumption Dashboard's GitHub page is not published.
claims.quote: Searched: "Consumption Dashboard" "GitHub" "license" licensing price. Read environment-requirements, ai-cost-dashboard, github-query and Copilot Analytics introduction; no GitHub-page-specific licensing requirement is stated.

claims.claim: The Copilot Analytics introduction's Consumption Dashboard access section specifies roles rather than a feature-specific licence.
claims.quote: How to access the Consumption Dashboard: Consumption insights are available to Insights Analysts with global partition access, Managers, and Microsoft 365 Global Administrators.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Why it matters; Cost and licensing; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The dashboard's credit figures are for reference only.
claims.quote: Credit usage information in this dashboard is for reference only.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Why it matters; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Official GitHub AI credit billing and detailed charges are on GitHub.com.
claims.quote: For official billing and detailed charges, visit the Microsoft 365 admin center for Copilot Credits or GitHub.com for GitHub AI credits.

claims.claim: The GitHub query documentation says measured employees can lack a Microsoft 365 Copilot licence because GitHub Copilot usage is not tied to it.
claims.quote: GitHub Copilot usage isn't tied to a Microsoft 365 Copilot license, so the employees you measure can include people who don't have a Microsoft 365 Copilot license.

claims.claim: The manager consumption-access control is at Viva Insights Admin portal > Settings > Manager settings > Grant managers scoped access to Consumption insights.
claims.quote: Sign in to the Viva Insights Admin portal with your admin credentials. On the left, select Settings, then Manager settings. ... Optionally, select Grant managers scoped access to Consumption insights.

claims.claim: No PowerShell or API equivalent for the Manager settings consumption-access option is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Insights Manager settings minimum team size Consumption insights PowerShell Microsoft Graph API. Read manager-settings and access-policy reference excerpts; no manager-scoped consumption-access operation is documented.

claims.claim: A Viva Insights Administrator can configure Manager settings.
claims.quote: Applies to: Viva Insights Administrator, AI admin

claims.claim: An AI admin can configure Manager settings.
claims.quote: Applies to: Viva Insights Administrator, AI admin

claims.claim: Managers cannot be granted consumption insights without also being granted Copilot insights.
claims.quote: You can't grant managers scoped access to Consumption insights if you don't grant them access to Copilot insights.

claims.claim: Minimum team size is at Viva Insights Admin portal > Settings > Manager settings > Minimum team size.
claims.quote: On the left, select Settings, then Manager settings. ... Confirm or change the Minimum team size.

claims.claim: No PowerShell or API equivalent for Minimum team size in Manager settings is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Insights Manager settings minimum team size Consumption insights PowerShell Microsoft Graph API. Read manager-settings, privacy-settings and access-policy reference excerpts; no Minimum team size operation is documented.

claims.claim: No PowerShell or API equivalent for enabling the GitHub page preview is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Insights GitHub page preview Privacy settings enable PowerShell API. Read ai-cost-dashboard, privacy-settings, Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy and personal/advanced-insights control excerpts; no GitHub preview-switch operation is documented.

claims.claim: Privacy settings is an Insights Administrator page.
claims.quote: Privacy settings | Manage privacy settings | X

claims.claim: Learn names the Privacy settings page but does not name the GitHub preview option's label.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Insights GitHub page preview Privacy settings enable PowerShell API. Read ai-cost-dashboard and the entire privacy-settings page; the former names Privacy settings, while the latter contains no GitHub option.

claims.claim: Individual web-app access is added at Microsoft 365 admin center > Settings > Microsoft Viva > Viva Insights > Set up and management > Microsoft Copilot Dashboard > Manage access settings for Microsoft Copilot Dashboard > Users > Add.
claims.quote: Go to the Settings tab and select Microsoft Viva, then Viva Insights. ... Set up and management ... Under Microsoft Copilot Dashboard, select Manage access settings for Microsoft Copilot Dashboard. ... At the top, select Users. ... At the bottom, select Add.

claims.claim: No API or PowerShell equivalent for the documented web-app Users/Add access-assignment operation is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Insights web app access add remove users groups Microsoft Graph PowerShell API membership. Read manage-settings-copilot-dashboard, Graph application-assignment and VFAM excerpts; none identifies an API for this Users/Add assignment.

claims.claim: The individual-user and group web-app access management procedure applies to AI Administrators.
claims.quote: Manage access to the Viva Insights web app for individual users and groups: Applies to: AI Administrator

claims.claim: Adding or removing users' web-app access takes effect in 24 hours.
claims.quote: When you add or remove users to the Viva Insights web app, the change will go into effect in 24 hours.

claims.claim: A feature-access policy's access setting is reached through Microsoft 365 admin center > Settings > Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy > Access setting, selecting the app and feature as explained in the note.
claims.quote: select Viva from the settings menu. ... Select the Settings tab and select Manage feature access. ... Select Create a policy. ... Name the policy and select the app and feature ... Select the Access setting option

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId "Viva Insights web app" -Name DisableFeatureForAll -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone creates the documented tenant-wide web-app disable policy.
claims.quote: Example: Turn off the Viva Insights web app for all users in your tenant ... ModuleId : VivaInsights FeatureId : Viva Insights web app Name : DisableFeatureForAll IsFeatureEnabled : false Everyone

claims.claim: The Viva Insights web app feature-access control supports tenant, group and user scope.
claims.quote: The AI admin can turn the Viva Insights web app on or off at the tenant, group, or user level using the Viva Insights web app feature access management control

claims.claim: Disabling web-app access removes the whole app, including its Consumption Dashboard, Copilot Dashboard, Copilot Analytics reports and analyst tools.
claims.quote: Turning this control off disables the entire app, which includes the Microsoft Copilot Dashboard, Copilot Analytics reports, and advanced analysis and admin tools.

claims.claim: The policy editor requires selecting the app and feature and choosing On or Off under Access setting.
claims.quote: Name the policy and select the app and feature for which you'd like to set the policy. Select the Access setting option and choose On or Off to enable or disable the feature.

claims.claim: Policy scope is selected as Everyone or Specific people and groups.
claims.quote: Select Everyone or Specific people and groups under Apply access settings to.

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 Global Administrators can also manage all the documented dashboard settings.
claims.quote: In addition to the roles described below, all settings can also be managed by Microsoft 365 Global Administrators.

claims.claim: Manager settings changes apply after one hour.
claims.quote: Changes to these settings will apply after one hour.

claims.claim: Learn instructs administrators to remove an analyst from the global partition to remove consumption-insights access.
claims.quote: To remove access to consumption insights for specific analysts, remove them from the global partition.

claims.claim: Removing an analyst from the global partition also removes all other global-partition experiences.
claims.quote: If you remove an analyst from the global partition, they lose access to all experiences in the global partition.

claims.claim: The printed command and its ModuleId, FeatureId, Name, IsFeatureEnabled and Everyone parameters exist in Exchange PowerShell and accept the printed parameter types.
claims.quote: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -FeatureId <String> -IsFeatureEnabled <Boolean> -ModuleId <String> -Name <String> [-Confirm] [-Everyone]

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The included licensing model describes this reporting option within the applicable licensed Viva Insights product, without claiming that a separate GitHub-page entitlement has been published.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot plans also include manager, leader, and advanced analysis for all employees who have an assigned Copilot license.
